grammar.summary: 本课讲一只名贵猫被绑架勒索的故事，语法上突出 would 表过去将来、if 条件句（与赎金挂钩），以及 considering... 引导的分词状语与 dear 一词多义的双关。叙事中还出现分词短语 fearing that... 作原因状语。

points.title: would 表示过去将来 (Future in the Past with would)
points.explanation: would + 动词原形表示从过去某时看将要发生的事。本课绑架信声称猫 would be returned（将被送还），并用 would keep his word（会守信），都是从写信/取钱那一刻看将来，故用 would。

examples.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of $1,000.
examples.cn: 写信人声称拉斯特斯安然无恙，只要拉姆齐太太愿意支付1,000英镑赎金，可以立即将猫送还。

examples.en: Mrs. Ramsay was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word.
examples.cn: 但拉姆齐太太确信绑架者是会履行诺言的。

points.title: 条件句 if (Conditionals with if)
points.explanation: 本课用 if 引导真实条件句：if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom（如支付赎金），主句用 would be returned（会被送还），主从句时态呼应（过去时 + would），表示在当时看来可实现的假设。

examples.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of $1,000.
examples.cn: 写信人声称拉斯特斯安然无恙，只要拉姆齐太太愿意支付1,000英镑赎金，可以立即将猫送还。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrases as Adverbials)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语可作原因/时间状语。本课 fearing that she would never see Rastus again 表「因为害怕再也见不到猫」而改变主意；Considering the amount she paid 表「考虑到所付的钱」，引出 dear 一词「昂贵」与「珍爱」的双关结语。

examples.en: At first she decided to go to the police, but fearing that she would never see Rastus again -- the letter had made that quite clear -- she changed her mind.
examples.cn: 一开始拉姆齐太太打算报告警察，但又害怕再也见不到拉斯特斯——这点，信上说得十分明白——于是便改变了主意。

examples.en: Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!
examples.cn: 想到她所花的那笔钱，她的心疼就具有双重意义了。

exercises.q: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and ______ be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsay paid a ransom of $1,000.
At first she decided to go to the police, but ______ that she would never see Rastus again... she changed her mind.（分词原因状语）
______ the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!（分词状语表「考虑到」）
用过去完成时填空：Three days after Rastus' disappearance, Mrs. Ramsay ______ an anonymous letter.（写出 receive 的过去式，注意此处为过去时收信，填 received）
下列哪个词与课文中 anonymous 的含义最接近？
